questions.question: What happens?
questions.subject: Yuta Okkotsu vs. Takako Uro vs. Ryu Ishigori

answer.item: With Kurourushi out of the way, Uro makes her move on Yuta

questions.question: What does Uro do?
questions.subject: Yuta Okkotsu vs. Takako Uro vs. Ryu Ishigori

answer.item: She sneaks up behind him and reveals herself by commenting on his usage of his reverse cursed technique, one of the abilities Yuta wanted to conceal

questions.question: What does Uro do first?
questions.subject: Yuta Okkotsu vs. Takako Uro vs. Ryu Ishigori

answer.item: Uro creates a wave of destruction that hits Yuta several meters away

questions.question: What does Ryu do?
questions.subject: Yuta Okkotsu vs. Takako Uro vs. Ryu Ishigori

answer.item: Ryu interrupts their conversation and inserts himself into the fight by firing Granite Blast, a wide-ranged blast of cursed energy

questions.question: What does Yuta do?
questions.subject: Yuta Okkotsu vs. Takako Uro vs. Ryu Ishigori

answer.item: Yuta calls Rika to his side and asks her to give him everything

questions.question: What does Yuta apply?
questions.subject: Yuta Okkotsu vs. Takako Uro vs. Ryu Ishigori

answer.item: Yuta to apply the Snake Eyes and Fangs sigil of the Inumkai clan to his mouth and activate cursed speech

questions.question: What happens?
questions.subject: Yuta Okkotsu vs. Takako Uro vs. Ryu Ishigori

answer.item: Cognizant of what's most likely to transpire next, all three sorcerers activate Domain Expansion at the same time

questions.question: What does Yuta do?
questions.subject: Yuta Okkotsu vs. Takako Uro vs. Ryu Ishigori

answer.item: Yuta is victorious without needing to kill his opponents, allowing him to ask for their points

questions.question: What does Ryu do?
questions.subject: Yuta Okkotsu vs. Takako Uro vs. Ryu Ishigori

answer.item: Ryu sits up and asks Yuta about the repeated conversations between him and Uro throughout the battle
